note: Editorial real-estate media for Lumen CRM premium themes. Natural colors only — theme is set by UI, never by a color filter on the photo (see CLAUDE.md: BURGUNDY IS NOT A PAGE FILTER).

items.purpose: Editorial media-hero for Лента in Lumen Burgundy. Contemporary concrete villa with mirror infinity pool at warm dusk; architecture right, negative space left under a neutral white gradient mask.
items.prompt: Premium editorial real-estate photography, contemporary Balinese luxury villa, travertine stone, teak wood, infinity pool mirror reflection, natural greenery, clean natural morning light, architecture on RIGHT third, LEFT 60% soft haze negative space for UI. No people/text/logos/HDR/color filter.

items.purpose: Editorial media-hero for База/Объекты in Lumen Burgundy. Stone-and-glass pavilion over a reflecting pool in a warm desert plateau; architecture right, big airy sky left.
items.prompt: Premium cinematic real-estate photography, contemporary luxury villa, stone and glass, calm reflecting pool, warm natural light, expansive negative space on the left. No people/text/logos/HDR/color filter.

items.purpose: Editorial media-hero for База/Объекты in Lumen Glass. Cool stone-and-wood residence over the ocean under a soft overcast sky; architecture right, cool negative space left — harmonizes with the glass blue accent.
items.prompt: Premium editorial real-estate photography, contemporary luxury residence, stone and wood, ocean cliff, soft overcast cool light, architecture on RIGHT third, LEFT negative space for UI. No people/text/logos/HDR/color filter.

login_video.note: Per-theme immersive login/loader videos already exist and are wired via THEME_VIDEO in app.js (assets/skyline-<theme>.mp4 + -poster.jpg). Burgundy=skyline-burgundy.mp4, Glass=skyline-glass.mp4. Not regenerated.
